about: The differential for background-check wording (review B2 L-2): every Unicode scalar value in ranges (start, end and step, in decimal; surrogates skipped), placed between "a" and "b", split into words under each folding. One line per code point: its upper-case hex, ":", then the words under join, split and v010, each joined with a space and the three joined with "/", ending in a line feed. digest is the sha-256 of all the lines: the page (core/test/harness/background-wording-differential.test.ts), native (background.rs tests) and ozzie.church (hosted-parity.test.ts) must all reach it, so they split every character the same way. A different digest on one side means its Unicode data differs from the others': add the characters to newer_unicode in background-wording.json.
